summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases under its program announced June 9, 2026. Between August 3-7, 2026, it bought 103,970 shares at an average price of €23.18 (approx. $27), totaling €2.41 million, via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary on Euronext venues. The company now holds 808,186 treasury shares. This is a routine buyback disclosure, a capital return to shareholders, not a tender offer or other special situation. Watch for ongoing repurchase pace and potential impact on share count and EPS.
